section.title: Cool Down Activity
section.para: Diego’s club earns money for charity when members of the club perform community service after school. For each student who does community service, the club earns $5. There are 12 students in the club.
The total dollar amount earned, \(E\), is a function of the number of members who perform community service, \(n\).

div.para: \(n=5\) is possible. It means that 5 students perform community service.

list.item: Is 5 a possible input value? Why or why not?

div.para: No, 24 is not possible as an output value. An output value has to be a multiple of 5.

list.item: Is 24 a possible output value? Why or why not?
